title: panda_chemistry_gym Capping-v1 (PyBullet Franka Panda)
intro: panda_chemistry_gym Capping-v1 (PyBullet Franka Panda), adapted from cooper-group-uol-robotics/panda_chemistry_gym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
